stadiums.name: Wankhede Stadium
stadiums.notes: Dew factor heavy in evening games. Short square boundaries. Sea breeze helps pacers in second innings.

stadiums.name: M. Chinnaswamy Stadium
stadiums.notes: Shortest boundaries in IPL. High altitude assists big hits. Scores consistently above 180.

stadiums.name: MA Chidambaram Stadium
stadiums.notes: Slow, turning surface. Spinners dominate. High dew in evening matches. CSK's fortress — rarely lose here.

stadiums.name: Eden Gardens
stadiums.notes: Largest IPL venue. Roaring crowd gives home advantage. Morning games offer pace, evening helps batters.

stadiums.name: Sawai Mansingh Stadium
stadiums.notes: Good batting track. Shorter straight boundaries. Spinners effective in 2nd innings.

stadiums.name: Arun Jaitley Stadium
stadiums.notes: Flat track. Strong wind can be unpredictable. Day games favour spinners; night games suit pacers.

stadiums.name: Punjab Cricket Association IS Bindra Stadium
stadiums.notes: Lively surface early on. Ball comes nicely onto bat. Short mid-wicket and long-on boundaries.

stadiums.name: Narendra Modi Stadium
stadiums.notes: World's largest cricket stadium. Surface suits both batters and pacers. Evening dew minimal.

stadiums.name: BRSABV Ekana Cricket Stadium
stadiums.notes: New venue. Pace-friendly early overs. Decent carry for seamers. Crowd support benefits LSG.

stadiums.name: Rajiv Gandhi International Cricket Stadium
stadiums.notes: One of the better batting surfaces. Even bounce. Short square boundaries assist big hitters.

stadiums.name: Brabourne Stadium
stadiums.notes: Alternate Mumbai venue. Smaller capacity. Sea breeze. Good contest between bat and ball.

stadiums.name: DY Patil Sports Academy
stadiums.notes: Used during IPL 2022. Good batting surface. Flat and even bounce throughout.

stadiums.name: Dubai International Cricket Stadium
stadiums.notes: Slowest surface used for IPL. Spinners dominate. Dew plays a factor in night games.

stadiums.name: Sheikh Zayed Cricket Stadium
stadiums.notes: Another slow UAE surface. Chasing teams benefit from dew. Low-scoring battles common.
